title: Combination of Chenpi and Banxia alleviates synovial inflammation in a rat model of rheumatoid arthritis by targeting the JNK/AP-1 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Wenxin; Li, Yue; Zhang, Xiaoyu; Zhang, Jie; Du, Yue; Han, Xu; Cui, Ronghao; Li, Yufeng; Meng, Fanyan; Meng, Di
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药组合对类风湿关节炎滑膜炎症的缓解作用，涉及JNK/AP-1信号通路，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接与MD模拟为辅助，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Chenpi (Citrus reticulata) has both medicinal and dietary applications, while Banxia (Pinellia ternata) is frequently combined with Chenpi to treat inflammatory diseases. This study aimed to investigate the potential therapeutic targets and pharmacological mechanisms of the Chenpi-Banxia (CB) herbal combination in rheumatoid arthritis (RA). METHODS: A collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rat model was used to evaluate the effects of CB on arthritis symptoms, histopathology, and serum cytokine levels. Network pharmacology was applied to identify active compounds and potential targets. Key components were analyzed by high-performance liquid chromatography, and molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to assess their interactions with JNK proteins. The regulatory effects of CB on the JNK/AP-1 pathway were further examined in leptin-induced fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs) and CIA rats. RESULTS: CB significantly reduced paw swelling and arthritis scores, ameliorated joint pathological damage, and decreased TNF-alpha and IL-6 levels in the serum and synovial tissues of CIA rats. Network pharmacology identified the JNK pathway as a key target. Among five candidate compounds detected in CB-containing serum, nobiletin showed the largest chromatographic peak area. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations supported stable interactions between nobiletin and JNK1/JNK2. In vitro, nobiletin and CB-containing serum inhibited leptin-induced FLS proliferation, migration, inflammatory factor release, JNK phosphorylation, and downstream c-Jun and c-Fos expression. In vivo, CB also suppressed JNK/AP-1 activation in synovial tissue. DISCUSSION: These findings suggest that CB alleviates experimental arthritis and synovial inflammation, at least partly by suppressing leptin-mediated JNK/AP-1 signaling and abnormal FLS activation, thereby supporting its potential therapeutic relevance in RA.
abstract_zh: 引言：陈皮（Citrus reticulata）兼具药用与食用价值，而半夏（Pinellia ternata）常与陈皮配伍用于治疗炎症性疾病。本研究旨在探讨陈皮-半夏（CB）药对在类风湿关节炎（RA）中的潜在治疗靶点及药理机制。方法：采用胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠模型评估CB对关节炎症状、组织病理学及血清细胞因子水平的影响。应用网络药理学识别活性化合物及潜在靶点。通过高效液相色谱分析关键成分，并进行分子对接和分子动力学模拟以评估其与JNK蛋白的相互作用。进一步在瘦素诱导的成纤维样滑膜细胞（FLSs）及CIA大鼠中检测CB对JNK/AP-1通路的调控作用。结果：CB显著减轻大鼠足爪肿胀和关节炎评分，改善关节病理损伤，并降低CIA大鼠血清及滑膜组织中TNF-α和IL-6水平。网络药理学将JNK通路确定为主要靶点。在CB含药血清中检测到的五种候选化合物中，川陈皮素（nobiletin）的色谱峰面积最大。分子对接和动力学模拟支持川陈皮素与JNK1/JNK2之间的稳定相互作用。体外实验中，川陈皮素和CB含药血清抑制瘦素诱导的FLS增殖、迁移、炎症因子释放、JNK磷酸化及下游c-Jun和c-Fos表达。体内实验中，CB同样抑制滑膜组织中JNK/AP-1的激活。讨论：这些发现表明，CB通过至少部分抑制瘦素介导的JNK/AP-1信号通路及异常FLS活化来缓解实验性关节炎和滑膜炎症，从而支持其在RA中的潜在治疗相关性。
